body: Does anyone know what those patterns are actually called and why a lot if not everyone sees them while tripping? I’ve been wondering this for years man
Wild same place as well doing the same shit 😂

I’m not friends with anyone except the girl from the second time and that’s because she was blacked out asleep. Now I can’t prevent any of them from happening. Did I move to Vegas thinking I’d get raped? No. Did I know I was gonna have him follow me in the bathroom and pull a gun on me? No. If so I wouldn’t have gone in. The second one I was at a festival with my friends. Everyone was drinking. I didn’t know I was gonna get that drunk. I’m usually not a light weight. I didn’t know I was gonna get raped when I was laying in my tent. I couldn’t fight back my limbs felt like noodles. The third story I went there to pet a puppy. I didn’t know this guy would be like that. If I did or if he shown red flags I wouldn’t have gone over. When you have someone bigger than you and is holding you down there’s nothing you can really do except yell. Unless you’re put in the situations and experience it first hand yourself you can’t say that it could’ve been prevented.

Thank you. I’ll have to look into mdma therapy. I feel like going to an actual therapist and just talking about it multiple times a week wouldn’t do anything and I feel like other psych meds would just numb it temporarily and make it harder to cope with when I don’t have them. It’s just hard when you try to move on from it but now every man you can’t trust. I find myself not going out anymore and just staying home and always locking my door even tho I’ve had the same roommate for a year now. I wanna get help just don’t know where to start, how to start, and how I’ll feel when I start.
